source_caption:
🎬 Labyrinth (1986)

Labyrinth follows Sarah Williams, a teenage girl whose ordinary life takes an extraordinary turn when she accidentally wishes for her baby brother to be taken away by the mysterious Goblin King, Jareth. When her wish unexpectedly comes true, Sarah must enter a magical labyrinth filled with strange creatures, confusing pathways, dangerous traps, and unforgettable characters to rescue him before time runs out. Along her journey, she encounters unusual companions who help her navigate the maze while facing challenges that test her courage, intelligence, and determination. Meanwhile, the charismatic Goblin King attempts to distract her from completing her mission. Combining imaginative storytelling, spectacular puppetry, memorable music, and breathtaking fantasy worlds, the film explores growing up, responsibility, friendship, and the power of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Adventure • Family • Musical

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 41m • PG

🎥 Director: Jim Henson

🏆 Recognition: Starring Jennifer Connelly and David Bowie, the film became a beloved fantasy cult classic, celebrated for Jim Henson’s extraordinary puppetry, imaginative creature designs, and David Bowie’s unforgettable performance and musical contributions.

source_details.synopsis: Labyrinth is a 1986 musical fantasy film directed by Jim Henson from a screenplay by Terry Jones based on a story conceived by Henson and Dennis Lee. A co-production between Henson Associates and Lucasfilm with George Lucas serving as executive producer, the film stars Jennifer Connelly as teenager Sarah and David Bowie as Jareth, and follows Sarah's journeys through a maze to save her baby brother from the Goblin King. Labyrinth started as a collaboration between Henson and Brian Froud following their previous collaboration The Dark Crystal (1982).
